t: This is Hoxton Hall, a performing arts theatre and community centre at 130 Hoxton Street in Hackney. It is still a place for performance and for the local community. The building is linked to James Mortimer, who lived from 1833 to 1911 and is credited with designing it. He was an American-born British chess player, journalist and playwright, so the person behind this hall had a varied career well beyond building design.
